log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Opponent has Primarina and Incineroar threatening Kingambit and Garchomp. Gholdengo blocks status and pressures Primarina; Sylveon handles Garchomp/Dragonite. Lead Gholdengo with Sylveon, keep Kingambit in back.
Opponent has strong Fairy/Steel core, so I need Gholdengo for Sylveon/Rotom and Incineroar for Kingambit/Gholdengo pivot. Garchomp leads for speed and Earthquake pressure.
Garchomp may outspeed and could carry Ground moves, but Make It Rain from Life Orb likely OHKOs or badly hurts it. Taking the KO now is better than risking a setup turn.
Garchomp outspeeds Gholdengo and Earthquake is super effective, likely an OHKO. Mega Evolving first boosts Attack to secure the knockout while still moving first.
Mega Garchomp's Earthquake hits Kingambit super effectively, while Sylveon resists Ground and can tank hits. Sylveon is the safer switch and can Wish or Yawn to handle Garchomp.
Sylveon likely carries Pixilate Fairy STAB which is super-effective and threatens to KO Garchomp. Gholdengo resists Fairy with Steel typing, so switching is the safe play.

Mega Garchomp outspeeds and its Earthquake hits Sylveon hard, but Sylveon is at full HP and can likely survive one hit. Yawn forces Garchomp to switch or fall asleep, gaining huge tempo. Attacking or switching wastes that pressure.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp likely outspeeds and EQ hits Sylveon hard. Kingambit resists EQ? Ground hits Steel neutrally... Kingambit is Dark/Steel: Ground is neutral? Steel weak to Ground, Dark neutral → 2x. Hmm. Sylveon takes big EQ. Yawn forces switch. Yawn is good—Garchomp must switch or sleep. But Sylveon may get KO'd. Yawn still best pressure; or switch Kingambit to tank. Kingambit takes 2x EQ but bulky. Yawn seems best.

decisions.thought: Sylveon wasted Yawn into Good as Gold and its Fairy STAB is resisted by Steel, so Gholdengo walls it. This is a free setup turn before Sylveon attacks.
Gholdengo is immune to status and Hyper Voice does nothing to Steel/Ghost, so Sylveon can't touch it. Kingambit resists its Steel moves and threatens it with Kowtow Cleave, so switch out.
Gholdengo at +2 still hits Kingambit not very effectively with both attacks, while Kingambit threatens a Dark STAB KO. This is a bad matchup to stay in.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups and switch options between Gholdengo and Kingambit while weighing speed and abilities.

decisions.thought: Kowtow Cleave is super effective with Supreme Overlord boost and should KO the +2 Gholdengo before it can sweep. Sucker Punch fails if it Nasty Plots again, and Swords Dance leaves us vulnerable to a boosted Make It Rain.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo at +2 threatens Make It Rain. Kowtow Cleave likely OHKOes (SE, Supreme Overlord boost). Speed uncertain—if Gholdengo is faster, it may attack first; but Kowtow Cleave likely KOs even after taking a hit? Risky. Sucker Punch is priority and works if it attacks; but if it Nasty Plots again, fails. Kowtow Cleave is best—likely OHKO.

decisions.thought: Incineroar resists both Dark and Steel, so my boosted attacks are weak, and it threatens Kingambit with super-effective Fire moves while I'm at -1 Attack. Sylveon walls Incineroar well and can Yawn or Hyper Voice it, pivoting safely while preserving Kingambit for later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Incineroar at 83%, Kingambit -1 Attack, Supreme Overlord boost (1 fainted ally = +10%? Actually Gholdengo fainted, so 1 ally = 10% boost... wait "fallen1" — one fallen ally). Kowtow Cleave is resisted. Incineroar likely has Knock Off / Parting Shot / Flare Blitz. Kingambit resists everything Incineroar has except maybe... Incineroar Fire/Dark; Kingambit Dark/Steel resists Fire? No — Steel weak to Fire, Dark neutral: Fire is super effective? Dark/Steel: Fire 2x? Steel weak to Fire, Dark neutral to Fire → 2x. So Incineroar threatens with Flare Blitz. But Kingambit is bulky.

Options: Swords Dance to boost despite -1? Or switch to Sylveon to avoid Intimidate stacking and Knock Off. Incineroar likely to U-turn/Parting Shot. Sylveon is a good pivot; Incineroar can't hurt Sylveon much (Fire neutral, Dark neutral... Sylveon Fairy: Incineroar's Knock Off neutral, Flare Blitz neutral). Sylveon can Yawn or Hyper Voice.

Actually staying in: Kowtow Cleave resisted, ~modest damage. Incineroar might Flare Blitz for big damage on Kingambit. Kingambit with Lum Berry, -1 Atk. Better to switch to Sylveon — Incineroar's Intimidate already hit; switching resets nothing but avoids Flare Blitz. Sylveon threatens Incineroar with Hyper Voice (neutral, 178 SpA). Also Yawn puts pressure. Switch seems good.

But wait — opponent's Gholdengo with +2 Nasty Plot is on bench, plus Garchomp. Sylveon handles Gholdengo? Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost, Sylveon Hyper Voice hits neutrally (Fairy vs Steel resisted? Fairy vs Steel is 0.5x; Pixilate makes it Fairy-type move → resisted). Hmm.

Sylveon vs Incineroar: Hyper Voice Pixilate = Fairy, neutral vs Fire/Dark. Good damage. Yawn forces switch. I'll switch to Sylveon.

decisions.thought: Flare Blitz is super effective on Kingambit and Incineroar outspeeds most variants, so it should score the knockout before taking another Kowtow.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a pivot with Parting Shot versus a direct KO with Flare Blitz against a weakened Kingambit while weighing type matchups.

decisions.thought: Sylveon is at 24% and Mega Incineroar's Flare Blitz will likely KO it this turn. Protect lets Leftovers tick and scouts, then I can Wish next turn or pivot to Kingambit safely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon at 24%, Incineroar Flare Blitz likely KOs. Protect to scout / Leftovers? Protect then Wish next turn? Protect stalls a turn, leftovers heal, then Wish. But Incineroar may just hit again. Protect is safest.

decisions.thought: Sylveon is at 23% so Flare Blitz should knock it out, and it also hits a likely Kingambit switch-in super-effectively.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating battle state and move options to choose between KOing Sylveon or pivoting with Parting Shot.

decisions.thought: Sylveon is at 29% and Mega Incineroar's Flare Blitz will likely KO it. Protect stalls a turn, gains Leftovers, and reveals Incineroar's next move before I commit to Wish or a switch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon at 29%, Incineroar Flare Blitz likely KOs. Protect to scout / stall leftovers? Protect then Wish next turn? Protect is safest; but Incineroar could use something else. Yawn? Protect seems fine.

decisions.thought: Sylveon is at 29% and just Protected, so it cannot Protect again and Flare Blitz will knock it out.
Sylveon fainted, so I must send in Kingambit, my only remaining Pokémon. Incineroar is at 70% and Kowtow Cleave is resisted, but Kingambit must fight alone now.

Incineroar resists both Dark and Steel, so attacking now does little. Kingambit resists Flare Blitz and outlasts it, so setting up Swords Dance while Supreme Overlord boosts stacking is the best play.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Incineroar resists Dark and Steel? Fire/Dark: Dark resists Dark, Fire resists... Steel neutral vs Fire, resisted by Fire? Steel vs Fire is resisted. So all attacks weak. Incineroar likely Flare Blitz — Kingambit resists Fire. Sucker Punch likely fails? Incineroar will attack, so Sucker Punch works and resists. But damage poor either way. Swords Dance boosts for late game; Kingambit resists Flare Blitz well. SD is best.

decisions.thought: Flare Blitz is super effective on Kingambit and Incineroar resists Kowtow Cleave, so staying in to attack is favored over switching to a bad matchup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Incineroar vs Kingambit matchup, type interactions, speed, and Parting Shot mechanics.
